events.label: founding
events.text: Klamath County established as a county of California, formed from Trinity County.

evidence.quote: Klamath County was a county of California from 1851 to 1874

events.text: County seat moved from Trinidad to Crescent City for larger population.

evidence.quote: In 1854 the county seat was moved to Crescent City

events.text: County seat moved inland to Orleans Bar, now Orleans.

evidence.quote: in 1856 , the county seat was moved inland , to Orleans Bar

events.label: boundary_change
events.text: Del Norte County, including Crescent City, split off from Klamath County.

evidence.quote: In 1857 , Del Norte County , including Crescent City , was split off from Klamath County

events.label: abolition
events.text: Klamath County abolished; territory divided between Siskiyou and Humboldt counties.

evidence.quote: In 1874 Klamath County was finally abolished , divided between Siskiyou and Humboldt counties
